# qrcodegen (C)

Project Nayuki's QR Code generator, vendored for the Steam download's sign-in
screen (port/steamdl/steam_job.c makes the QR of Steam's challenge URL; the
menus draw it).

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator, tag `v1.8.0`,
`c/qrcodegen.c` and `c/qrcodegen.h`, unmodified.

Licence: MIT (`LICENSE`, the notice from the files' headers; also
`LICENSES/MIT-qrcodegen.txt`), compatible with the project's GPL-3.0-only.
